steps: Ensure DC CIRCUIT BREAKER (9) is pushed in
Ensure EMERGENCY STOP switch (13) is pulled out
Place START / RUN / STOP switch (7) in the RUN position
Ensure LOW OIL PRESSURE indicator (16) is illuminated
Place START/RUN/STOP switch (7) in the START position to crank engine
Release switch to RUN position once engine starts
Adjust generator set voltage as required using the VOLTAGE ADJUST rheostat (10)
Place the CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER switch (11) in the CLOSED position
Place the CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER switch (11, Figure 2-3) in the OPEN position
Allow unit to run in this condition for approximately 3-5 minutes to cool down the engine
Place the START / RUN / STOP switch (7) in the STOP position to shut down generator set
Pull out DC CIRCUIT BREAKER (9)
Push in DC CIRCUIT BREAKER (7, Figure 2-4)
Pull out EMERGENCY STOP switch (8)
Place the START / RUN / STOP switch (5) in the RUN position
Open the generator set main access cover
Lift actuator lever (1) to the maximum fuel position and press in lock pin (2)
Pull out recoil starter handle (3) to the point where you feel strong resistance
Pull decompression lever (4) down
Pull out recoil starter handle (3) briskly with both hands
Place the START / RUN / STOP switch (5) in the START position, then move it back to the RUN position
Slowly lower the lever, allowing the electronic governor to take over
Unlock generator set main access cover latches and lift cover to open
Locate voltage selector switch access door (3) on top of power inverter / converter (4)
Close generator set main access cover and lock using latches

a: If engine does not run after third attempt, refer to Troubleshooting
b: Ensure DC CIRCUIT BREAKER (9) is pushed in

text: Do not crank engine for more than 15 seconds. Damage to starter motor can occur. Wait 15 seconds before attempting to crank again.

a: Mismatch will cause damage to equipment and may result in injury to personnel
b: Set voltage selector switch to match load cable voltage connections

text: Exhaust discharge contains deadly gases including carbon monoxide. Do not operate generator set in enclosed area unless exhaust discharge is properly vented outside.
Never attempt to start the generator set if it is not properly grounded.

a: reset the LOW OIL PRESSURE fault on the malfunction indicator module

value: Significant cracks in any generator set component.

row: Check if DC CIRCUIT BREAKER is tripped.
Check that GROUND FAULT CIRCUIT INTERRUPTER (GFCI) is not tripped.
